## Download

| Your device | File | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| 💻 **Mac**, macOS 12 or newer | **Swapboard-mac.zip** | Open it, then open **Swapboard** and follow its window. |
| 📱 **Android**, Android 10 or newer | **Swapboard.apk** | Easiest: scan the code in the Mac's setup window with your phone's camera. |
| 🎩 Alfred *(optional)* | Swapboard.alfredworkflow | Only if you use Alfred with the Powerpack. Install the Mac app first. |

New to Swapboard? The [setup guide]({{REPO_URL}}#readme) walks you through everything, including what to do if macOS or Android shows a warning.
